facts.statement: Klaus aims to provide a secure and powerful hosted OpenClaw solution that is simple to run without requiring complex setup.
Klaus runs OpenClaw by giving each user their own EC2 instance preconfigured with keys and integrations.
Klaus depends on OpenClaw and integrates with OpenRouter, AgentMail, Orthogonal, Slack, and Google Workspace using OAuth apps.
Klaus charges $19/month for a t4g.small instance, $49/month for t4g.medium, and $200/month for t4g.xlarge with priority support.
Klaus offers Starter, Plus, Pro, and Managed Rollout pricing tiers with varying AI and Orthogonal credits, and cloud instance quality.
Klaus announced it will shut down on September 1, 2026 and no longer accepts new subscriptions.
Klaus' Hacker News thread titled 'Show HN: Klaus – OpenClaw on a VM, batteries included' received 160 points and 91 comments 5 months ago from retrieval date (August 23, 2026).
Klaus integrates with many third-party services including Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Microsoft, Google, Zoom, Notion, Discord, GitHub, Stripe, Apollo, Zendesk, Intercom, and more.
